resources.string: Remote system notification (toast), not a message box or mobile push. Title: up to 160 characters; message: up to 512. Review the fixed targets before sending. Requires a connected agent, permissions and remote graphical-session support. Server acceptance does not prove display or reading. One attempt per device, no automatic resend. Stopping does not retract notifications already sent.
Accepted by the server; display and reading unconfirmed
